text: 美联储主席沃什：在美国，我们现在把AI称为“SI”。 人工智能（AI）对经济需求侧的影响将先于其供给侧冲击显现。 人工智能是我一生中最具深远影响的经济变革。 人工智能将有助于央行对数据及货币政策更有信心。 人工智能将改变实体经济，但对就业的短期影响仍存在不确定性。 人工智能将使经济效率更高、创造更多财富，但通往这一目标的道路将会充满波折。 美联储将于11月16日在旧金山湾区举行关于人工智能的现场听证会。
text_en: Fed Chair Warsh: In the United States, we now call AI “SI.” The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the demand side of the economy will appear before its supply-side shock. Artificial intelligence is the most far-reaching economic transformation of my lifetime. Artificial intelligence will help central banks be more confident about data and monetary policy. Artificial intelligence will transform the real economy, but the short-term impact on employment remains uncertain. Artificial intelligence will make the economy more efficient and create more wealth, but the path to that goal will be bumpy. The Federal Reserve will hold an in-person hearing on artificial intelligence on November 16 in the San Francisco Bay Area.
